classificationNotes: Source-draft Golems are treated as a constructed visual and encounter-production family. Statements about servitude, animation, life, free will, makers, rank, and agency are proposals rather than accepted metaphysics or social taxonomy. The packet preserves blocky workmanship progression and readable magical joints without asserting universal personhood.
visualConstants: Blocky heavy humanoid construction, oversized hands, small or absent head, blank carved face, and visible joint gaps remain legible.
Clay, fieldstone, iron banding, granite, basalt, marble, gold inlay, and gemstone stay distinct construction materials.
Runes and seam light remain bounded animation hardware rather than generic affinity spectacle.
Workmanship and material quality progress from fingerprints and one scratched rune to sculptural relief and a gemstone heart.
escalationAxis: Workmanship, material quality, and programmable rune behaviors rise from crude clay to a sovereign monument that reconfigures the arena.

constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity rune glow, seam glow, stone, clay, material quality, and the T4 molten core are source construction and animation signals rather than Fire, Earth, or generic affinity evidence.
Weight, tool marks, iron bindings, joint gaps, carved relief, and gemstone refraction remain material-specific with no elemental wake.
normal.counterplaySignal: The established scratched rune, iron band, engraved program line, plate gap, molten core shutter, or gemstone heart remains visible.
forbidden: Treating native masonry or animation light as affinity

constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo; T4 alone gains source-supported floating plates and a molten core; T5 alone gains a gemstone heart and rune-halo.
Added Fire construction uses external charcoal fuel grooves, heat-blackened bands, cycling furnace shutters, smoke vents, and cooling seams distinct from native animation light or the T4 source core.
fire.counterplaySignal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo, so a fuel groove exposes the joint rune; T4 floating plates expose its molten core shutter; T5 gemstone heart and rune-halo desynchronize at the cooling seam.
forbidden: Calling native seam light Fire affinity

constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo; T4 alone gains source-supported floating plates and a molten core; T5 alone gains a gemstone heart and rune-halo.
Affinity mineral laminates, compressed sediment joints, crystal load keys, planted dust, and pale fracture lines modify load paths without confusing native stone material with Earth affinity.
earth.counterplaySignal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo, so the loaded sediment key reveals a fracture; T4 floating plates expose its molten core brace; T5 gemstone heart and rune-halo strain one gold-inlaid fault.
forbidden: Treating all stone Golems as Earth-affined

constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo; T4 alone gains source-supported floating plates and a molten core; T5 alone gains a gemstone heart and rune-halo.
Carved pressure ducts, directional joint vanes, dust streamers, aerodynamic relief channels, and a still gap at the active joint make force routing visible.
wind.counterplaySignal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo, so a still joint gap interrupts the vane route; T4 floating plates expose its molten core brace; T5 gemstone heart and rune-halo pause over one pressure anchor.

constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo; T4 alone gains source-supported floating plates and a molten core; T5 alone gains a gemstone heart and rune-halo.
Inset cistern channels, wet reflective joints, coherent pressure tubes, drainage ports, and mineral-sealed valves create hydraulic motion distinct from native material quality.
water.counterplaySignal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo, so pressure loss reveals the joint rune; T4 floating plates expose its molten core brace after quenching; T5 gemstone heart and rune-halo stall when the main valve drains.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Probe timing with one clumsy command-rune swing.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the scratched forehead rune fires before the uneven limb moves.
forms.signatureMechanic: Wet Command: the single rune brightens and stiffens one fingerprinted arm for a delayed sweep.
forms.telegraph: The forehead scratch lights while wet clay bunches at one shoulder.
forms.counterplay: Step behind the stiffening arm and smear the exposed shoulder seam during recovery.
forms.visualDelta: Crude lumpy clay figure with uneven limbs, fingerprints, one forehead rune, and no advanced hardware.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Hold a short front with fieldstone mass and alternating iron-bound joints.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the active iron band transfers load and leaves the opposite joint open.
forms.signatureMechanic: Band Brace: one iron binding locks while the opposite stone arm repeats a reliable shove.
forms.telegraph: One faint seam brightens and its iron band pulls tight.
forms.counterplay: Strike the slack opposite band after the shove to separate two fieldstones.
forms.visualDelta: Fieldstone body, iron bands, faint joint seams, blank slab face, and mature baseline proportions.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Clay Figures attack from the braced side; breaking the band opens both lanes.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a programmable combo whose torso runes visibly announce three ordered actions.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach players to read engraved rune order and interrupt the unused final program.
forms.signatureMechanic: Three-Line Program: torso runes illuminate from top to bottom for guard, anvil-fist, then ground pin; breaking the currently dark line deletes that future action.
forms.telegraph: Three engraved torso rows light one at a time while the matching granite joint rotates.
forms.counterplay: Attack the lowest still-dark rune between actions to shorten the sequence and expose both anvil fists.
forms.visualDelta: Properly proportioned carved granite body, torso-wide engraved runes, and stone fists shaped like anvils.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Stone Servants brace the programmed lane; breaking their band removes the guard line.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Control space by orbiting separated basalt plates between shield wall and crushing ring.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the native molten core is visible only when plate spacing changes.
forms.signatureMechanic: Plate Orbit: floating basalt plates widen into a ring, exposing the molten chest core before converging on marked lanes.
forms.telegraph: Joint gaps widen, plate edges align, and the molten core pulses through the chest cavity.
forms.counterplay: Cross a widening gap and strike the core shutter before the plates converge.
forms.visualDelta: Huge black basalt body with source-supported floating plates and molten chest core.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Rune Warriors supply one program line to the orbit; deleting it leaves a permanent gap.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Command a relief-carved arena that assembles and disassembles lower golem stations around a central monument.
forms.teachingGoal: Test rune timing, band loads, program order, and plate gaps as permanent pieces of one authored boss arena.
forms.signatureMechanic: Arena Command — Master's Relief: the rune-halo selects a wall relief that produces a Clay Figure, Stone Servant, Rune Warrior, or plate pattern; solving that form's counterplay turns its relief inward and exposes one facet of the gemstone heart.
forms.telegraph: One halo rune descends over a gold-inlaid relief while the matching heart facet refracts toward it.
forms.counterplay: Answer the selected lower-form lesson and break the exposed heart facet; each broken facet permanently blanks its relief station.
forms.visualDelta: White marble monument with gold inlay, sculptural relief, gemstone heart, and a rune-halo above the shoulders.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Each lower form occupies one relief station; resolving its learned weak point converts that station into a permanent opening on the Master Golem.
